standard.summary: 默认关闭。开启后允许 Vortex 在低显存压力下收紧
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Off by default. Once enabled, Vortex is allowed to tighten up under low-VRAM pressure
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 默认关闭。开启后允许 Vortex 在低显存压力下收紧 prefetch/缓存策略；不会启用 active rematerialization。

advanced_en.principle: Off by default. When on, Vortex may tighten prefetch/cache policies under low-VRAM pressure; it does not enable active rematerialization.
